_readme: The IV Phases™ integration for every guided Co.LLab™ IP, applied when the quests load (netlify/functions/lib/quests.js), so the base quests in content/quests/ can be rebuilt from the PDFs without losing it and saved member answers stay keyed to the same ids. Per quest: fix = clearer wording for a prompt (its phase is kept); pin = the phase a prompt belongs to (0 Foundations, 1 Infrastructure Planning & Management, 2 Internal Operating Systems, 3 Preservation); drop = PDF-extraction leftovers that are not questions; add = new prompts written for that IP (workbooks get them as steps; snapshots, checklists, worksheets and starters get them as optional 'carry it through' steps so their scoring is unchanged); after = insert a prompt straight after another; shortPath = the steps of the short path on long quests; guide = the deliverable and how to put it to work in each of the four phases.
